content:
Acquirent is an outsourced sales execution and sales development company that helps businesses to rapidly expand their sales pipelines, create leads, and streamline customer acquisition. Acquirent's B2B sales team is well-versed in the hurdles of B2B sales and has a blend of experienced proven outreach methods, sales professionals, & data-driven processes that enable businesses to reach scalable revenue growth.

The company's core business is to provide its products to organizations looking to complement their sales development efforts. Acquirent empowers companies to connect with prospects, qualify leads more quickly, and offer more conversion opportunities as an extension of their internal sales team.

How Acquirent Works?

Acquirent helps organisations to design and build their sales development programs to align with their goals and markets. Its approach combines:

  • Data-driven outreach strategies
  • Dedicated sales teams
  • Lead qualification
  • Appointment setting
  • Sales development & prospecting

Through performance analytics, a structured outreach strategy, and trained sales personnel, Acquirent helps businesses:

  • Trading without significant internal recruitment efforts.
  • Perk up customer acquisition efforts.
  • Accelerate pipeline development
  • Scaling down sales without considerable onboarding efforts.
  • Make outbound prospecting more efficient.
  • Create quality leads + sales opportunities.

Core Capabilities

Global Talent Acquisition

Trained Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) who are essentially part of a business's internal sales team.

Sales Development Services

This comprises outbound prospecting, lead nurturing, and appointment setting services to help develop the sales pipeline.

B2B Lead Generation

Targets and connects with top-quality leads through targeted outreach efforts

Data & Analytics

Utilizes sales performance and reporting data to optimise the approach to outreach to support conversions.

Optimization of the Sales Process

improves the engagement approach and messaging, streamlines the procedure, and adds to consistency and efficiency.

What makes Acquirent special?

  • Sales experts with expertise and acquaintance in B2B prospecting & outreach.
  • Highlight on sales development & outsourcing pipeline generation.
  • The capability to scale up the sales without making large internal sales teams.
  • Experience working with lead qualification & appointment setting programs.
  • Customized sales engagement tactics for industry & objectives.

Key Services

  • End-to-End Outsourced Sales Development - Prospecting & Pipeline Development Services.
  • Lead Qualification - Sales Ready Lead qualification for improved conversion rates.
  • Appointment Setting - Setting appointments between the client sales team and prospects.
  • Pipeline Management - Creating a steady pipeline of growth opportunities.
  • Sales Strategy Consultation - Improved sales strategy consultation and outreach.
  • Market Expansion Services - Supporting clients in entering new markets and customer segments.

Advanced Capabilities

  • Sales Teams–Adaptable sales teams as per client goals and target audience.
  • Multi-channel outreach–Using digital outreach channels, phone calls, and emails for effective prospecting.
  • Sales training & enablement–Improving effectiveness in outbound prospecting, communication strategies, and more.
  • Marketing automation–Making it easier to conduct marketing campaigns & automation efforts.
  • Performance reporting–Giving you actionable insights and analysis on pipeline management and campaign performance.

Who must work with this Platform?

Big Enterprises

  • Are looking to complement lead qualification processes and pipeline generation
  • Seeking scalable outbound sales development help
  • Improving the scope of the sales activities in other industries or regions

Mid-Market Firms

  • Seek to enhance customer acquisition and engagement with prospects.
  • To ensure that dedicated appointment setting and SDR support is provided.
  • Going through rapid expansion in sales without an equivalent increase in internal personnel

Best-Fit Industries

  • Telecommunications- companies looking to improve lead conversion and communication with customers
  • Professional Services- business service companies, marketing, and consulting desire pipeline expansion
  • Manufacturing- expanding businesses in the field of customer acquisition.
  • Financial- These include financial services businesses that require B2B sales outreach (relationship-driven).
  • Life Sciences + Healthcare- companies that are pursuing enterprise clients and healthcare providers
  • Software & Technology- technology providers and SaaS companies who are looking for scalable lead generation.

Key Use Cases

  • Customer Acquisition Campaigns- enhancing prospect engagement and brand visibility with strategic outreach.
  • SDR Team Augmentation- helping internal sales teams through dedicated prospecting resources.
  • Marketing Development Programs- new product lines or markets for existing products
  • Appointment Setting Programs- making appointments with decision makers of high value
  • Sales Pipeline Acceleration- boosting the quality and speed of pipeline development
  • Inbound Leads- capturing qualified leads and connecting with prospects.

Pros

  • Talented SDR teams + outreach staff
  • Quickly qualify leads + generate pipelines.
  • Supporting scalable sales efforts out-of-house
  • Knowledge of the industry, precise to prospecting + sales development

Considerations

  • If you have immensely specialized products, you may require customizing the same and getting more training.
  • The outsourced workforce may need to be onboarded to align with the company’s culture, in addition to messaging.
  • Given the clear lines of communication and separate sales goals, effectiveness is key.

Top Alternatives to Consider

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • Operatix- technology pipeline generator for B2B businesses
  • Sales Roads- A sales team outsourcing inside sales or appointment setting service
  • Martal Group- Lead Generation Support and B2B sales outsourcing
  • CIENCE- outbound prospecting services and sales research

Takeaway

Acquirent provides businesses with speed, an optimized lead generation process, and professional SDR support and outbound prospecting. B2B companies can grow their revenue on the platform and acquire customers regularly, due to its data-driven approach.

Looking to accelerate your sales funnel? Acquirent can help accomplish improved sales performance and outcomes.
